title: OFFER LINE AND USE BAR GROW AT 4K
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, the same size on every screen. The trade offer line under the boss plate and the caption over the bandage, medkit and plate bar kept their 1080p size on a 4K screen, small print beside a HUD drawn twice as big. Both now grow with the screen: the offer line and its plate are drawn at the screen scale and the controller word under it moves down with it, and the use bar caption and the room around it grow by the same factor. At 1080p nothing moves.
now: On a 4K screen the trade offer line and the bandage bar caption are now as big as the rest of the HUD.
